introduction: Bloodsoaked Media in 2026 is not a beginning. It is a return. Dakota's published writing started in 2015 with Metal Lifestyle — years of reviews, editorials, and criticism filed across eras, a brief early Bloodsoaked run, quiet years while collections grew, and now a relaunch built to hold new work beside recovered archive pieces.

events.title: Metal Lifestyle Launches
events.description: An independent media publication focused on games, film, music, television, and culture. This marks the beginning of Dakota's published writing archive.

events.title: The Metal Lifestyle Years
events.description: Reviews, editorials, essays, recommendations, and media criticism published across multiple years. This era forms the foundation of the archive. Future recovered articles should reference this period.

events.title: Bloodsoaked Media Emerges
events.description: A new publication identity begins to take shape. The project shifts toward a darker aesthetic and a stronger focus on personal curation, horror influences, physical media, and collector culture.

events.title: Original Bloodsoaked Media Run
events.description: Bloodsoaked Media operates for a brief period. Although short-lived, this establishes the publication identity that will later return.

events.title: The Quiet Years
events.description: The publication is inactive. The archive remains dormant while collections grow, media accumulates, and future ideas take shape. An intermission — not a disappearance.

events.title: Bloodsoaked Media Returns
events.description: The publication relaunches as a long-term independent archive and media journal — new writing, media logs, collections, reviews, essays, and archive restoration filed together.

events.title: The Shelf Stays Open
events.description: Bloodsoaked Media continues to expand through new writing, archive recovery, collection documentation, and ongoing media exploration.
